completeness_assessment.issue: Column payments.gateway has no constraints documented but is used in categorical analysis and should likely have NOT NULL constraint
completeness_assessment.recommendation: Add NOT NULL constraint to payments.gateway in the data glossary to ensure data quality

completeness_assessment.issue: Column products.category_id is marked as FK and NOT NULL, but the self-referencing product_categories.parent_category_id is FK but nullable, which may cause confusion in hierarchy traversal
completeness_assessment.recommendation: Add explicit documentation in the glossary explaining that parent_category_id is nullable for root categories

accuracy_assessment.issue: Data glossary marks payments.amount as PII, but the semantic model field description does not emphasize this sensitivity (though it is mentioned in the dataset-level ai_context)
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Ensure PII designation is consistently documented at both the glossary column level and the semantic model field level for all sensitive fields

efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Create a shared metadata definition or reference for common technical columns (_source_system, _batch_id, _loaded_at) to reduce duplication and improve maintainability
